operations.before:
index_expression: $ => prec(PREC.primary, prec.dynamic(1, seq(
      field('operand', $._expression),
      '[',
      field('index', $._expression),
      ']',
operations.after:
index_expression: $ => prec(PREC.primary, prec.dynamic(1, seq(
      field('operand', $._expression),
      '[',
      commaSep1(field('index', $._expression)),
      optional(','),
      ']',

choice(seq(field('initializer', $._simple_statement), choice(';', newline)), ';'),
      choice(seq(field('condition', $._expression), choice(';', newline)), ';'),

field('receiver', $.parameter_list),
      optional($._line_end_check),
      field('name', $._field_identifier),
      field('type_parameters', optional($.type_parameter_list)),
      optional($._line_end_check),
      field('parameters', $.parameter_list),
